conditions: Every fused artifact must expose compatible identity scope.

claims.statement: Retrieval generation identity binds source, embedding, configuration, and artifact identities into a stable generation ID.
Candidate artifacts are staged and validated before activation; activation changes the current generation only with supplied authority.
Cross-generation fusion can return semantically plausible but evidentially invalid results and therefore must fail closed.
